blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) chairperson Dir. Jose Maria “Joey” Reyes on Wednesday suggested lowering cinema ticket prices to encourage more people to go out and watch movies again. Reyes, who has been in the film industry for over four decades, made the assertion before the Senate committee on public information and mass media hearing on proposed bills establishing the National Film Commission. Of the three Senate versions of the measure, Senate Bill No. 479 proposes funding a Philippine Film Commission through a “special film commission tax” of P2 on each movie ticket sold in the […]...
